simple.meaning: אָמֵן (ʼâmên) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “sure ; abstract, faithfulness ; adverb, truly.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 30 times across Numbers, Deuteronomy, 1 Kings, 1 Chronicles, Nehemiah, and 3 more, beginning at Numbers 5:22. Its contexts include family, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָמֵן (H543).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אָמֵן (ʼâmên) / H543 is traced through Numbers 5:22, Deuteronomy 27:15, Deuteronomy 27:16, Deuteronomy 27:17 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H543. amen אָמֵן adverb verily, truly Deut 27:15 , 26 (12 t.) 1Kin 1:36 ; Neh 5:13 ; Jer 11:5 ; 28:6 & doxologies 1Chr 16:36 ( = Psa 106:48 ); אָמֵן (ו) אָמֵן Num 5:22 (P) Neh 8:6 , & in the doxologies Psalm 41:14; Psa 72:19 ; 8:9 Psalm 48. ἀμήν = Amen: אָמֵן אֱלֹהֵי Isa 65:16 (twice in verse) God of Amen De Che RVm; compare Rev 3:14 , or God of faithfulness, God of truth (RV) (perhaps read אֹמֶן Che Di).
